You regain all expended uses of Polar Soul when you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Winter Avatar
entries: When you use your Channel Divinity, you can transform into the Avatar of Winter for 1 minute. While in this form, you have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage, and you have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Cold damage. Hostile creatures within 10 feet of yourself have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against creatures other than you. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Circle of the Ursids
entries: The Ursids are among the most dominant tribes of the Freljord, devoted to the Bear Spirit known as Volibear. Volibear is fiercely protective of the Freljord and scorns the weakness brought by civilization, yearning for a return to the Old Ways. Those who carry out his will become exceptionally powerful skinchangers, though this transformation also makes them destructive, savage, and fiercely resolute.

subclassFeature.name: Circle Spells
entries: When you reach a Druid level specified in the Circle of the Ursids Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.
In addition, you can cast the spells from this feature while you're in a Wild Shape form.

subclassFeature.name: Stormclaw Transformation
entries: You can channel the destructive essence of Volibear. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend one use of Wild Shape to assume an ursine hybrid form. This form lasts for 10 minutes, until you end it (no action required), or until you become {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB}. This form counts as a use of Wild Shape.
While transformed, you gain the following benefits:

items: {@bold Winter's Fur.} You gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your Druid level.

{@bold Stormclaws.} Your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes} deal {@damage 1d6} Slashing damage. You can use your Wisdom modifier instead of Strength for the attack and damage rolls of these attacks.

{@bold Bear Frenzy.} When you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action on your turn, you can make one additional attack with your Stormclaws as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of 1), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
{@bold Thunderous Step.} Your walking speed increases by 10 feet.

subclassFeature.name: Lightning Claws
entries: While you are in your Ancient Gods Transformation or Wild Shape, your weapon attacks and {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes} are infused with electrical energy. While in either of these forms, you gain the following benefits:

entries.name: Conversion
entries: When you hit with an attack, you can choose to deal Lightning damage instead of the attack's normal damage type.

entries.name: Chain Shock
entries: Once per turn, when you deal damage to a creature with your Stormclaws, you can unleash a bolt of lightning. One other creature of your choice within 10 feet of the target takes {@damage 1d6} Lightning damage.

subclassFeature.name: Skybreaker
entries: You gain {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Lightning and Thunder damage.
And the damage die of your Stormclaws increases to {@damage 1d8}.

When you cast {@spell Call Lightning|XPHB}, the first bolt of lightning created by the spell deals maximum damage instead of rolling its damage dice. If you are within the area of a spell you cast that deals Lightning damage, you can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to absorb part of its energy, gaining {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your Druid level.

subclassFeature.name: Wrath of the Thousand-Wounded Bear
entries: At 14th level, you fully awaken the power of your Stormclaw Transformation, gaining the following benefits.

entries.name: Unstoppable Storm
entries: Your Chain Shock deals {@damage 2d6} Lightning damage, and it can affect one additional creature within 20 feet of the original target, for a maximum of two creatures.

entries.name: Demigod's Impact
entries: When you cast {@spell Destructive Wave|XPHB}, the spell save DC increases by 2. One creature of your choice that fails its saving throw is {@condition Stunned|XPHB} until the start of your next turn. Once you use this effect, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Dauntless Vanguard
entries: Peerless warriors and enemies of the supernatural, the Dauntless Vanguards stand on the front lines against magical horrors. Though trained primarily to face rogue mages and demons, Demacian steel cuts through anyone all the same.

subclassFeature.name: Piercing Line
entries: {@b Courage.} You are undaunted by the enemies before you. You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition.

{@b Counterattack.} When you are hit by a melee attack, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to attempt a counterattack. To do so, make an attack roll and compare the result to the attack roll that hit you. If your attack roll meets or exceeds the creature's attack roll, the attack misses instead. You take no damage and suffer none of the attack's effects, and you can deal damage as normal with your weapon.

subclassFeature.name: Spellbreaker
entries: When you hit a creature with a melee attack, you can expend one use of Second Wind as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to produce the same effect as {@spell Dispel Magic|XPHB}.
Choose Strength or Dexterity as your supernatural ability. Your Supernatural DC equals 8 + your Proficiency Bonus + your chosen ability modifier.

subclassFeature.name: Perseverance
entries: When you use your Second Wind to regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, you draw strength from your allies. You gain 5 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} for each ally within 20 feet of yourself.
You can use this feature once per {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Crescent Guard
entries: While you are Bloodied, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to protect yourself and your allies within 30 feet of yourself who can hear you. Until the start of your next turn, each affected creature has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to all damage.
You can use this feature once per {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: JUSTICE!
entries: When you hit a target with an attack, you can draw upon your full strength to deliver true justice. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can deal an extra {@damage 6d10} Force damage to the target, which must then make a Wisdom saving throw against your Supernatural DC.
On a failed save, the target suffers the following effects until the start of your next turn:

items: Its Speed is reduced to 0.
It can't take {@variantrule Action|XPHB|Actions}, {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB|Reactions}, {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB|Bonus Actions}, or Legendary Actions.
It automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saving throws.

entries: You can use this feature once per {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Outlaw
entries: What defines an outlaw is not simply the weapon they wield or the way they fight. An outlaw, above all else, is a fighter with cunning charm and swagger. With brazen arrogance, outlaws craft their own custom firearms to perfectly match their unconventional personalities. Particularly wealthy outlaws may even possess customized Hextech weapons, but such individuals are rare among Bilgewater's rogues. Do not mistake their swagger for an empty façade: those who underestimate an outlaw's skill with firearms tend to end up dead.

subclassFeature.name: Brazen Charm
entries: Starting at 3rd level, your audacity is matched only by your wit. Whenever you make a Charisma ability check, you add your Intelligence modifier to the roll (minimum bonus of +1).
In addition, you gain proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: {@skill Deception}, {@skill Performance}, or {@skill Persuasion}.

subclassFeature.name: Firearm Specialist
entries: Starting at 3rd level, you can construct a special firearm at no cost, designed so that only you can properly wield it. Choose one of the following firearm designs. You gain the corresponding firearm.

items: {@item Outlaw Pistol|Arcamis}
{@item Outlaw Rifle|Arcamis}

subclassFeature.name: Firearm Upgrades
entries: Your Firearm Specialist weapon is enhanced by your ingenuity. You can apply 1 {@filter Minor Upgrade|optionalfeatures|Feature Type=MU} and 1 {@filter Major Upgrade|optionalfeatures|Feature Type=MAU} to your firearm.
Your firearm improves as you gain levels in this subclass. You gain one additional Minor Upgrade at 5th level and another at 10th level, and one additional Major Upgrade at 15th level.
Whenever you gain a new upgrade from this feature, you can replace one upgrade currently applied to your firearm with another upgrade of the same grade for which you qualify.
The saving throw DC for your firearm's abilities equals 8 + your Proficiency Bonus + your Intelligence modifier.

subclassFeature.name: Hit-and-Run
entries: You gain proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: {@skill Acrobatics} or {@skill Sleight of Hand}.

Once per turn, when you take the Attack action using a weapon granted by your Firearm Specialist feature, you can forgo adding your ability modifier to the damage roll to make a retreating maneuver, moving up to half your Speed without provoking {@variantrule Opportunity Attacks|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Frightening Weaponry
entries: Your firearms inspire fear in common foes. You gain proficiency in {@skill Intimidation}. If you already have proficiency in Intimidation, you instead gain Expertise in it. In addition, when you hit a creature with a firearm granted by your Firearm Specialist feature, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to attempt to frighten one of the creatures you hit. The creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against a DC equal to the result of your Charisma (Intimidation) check or have the Frightened condition until the start of your next turn.

subclassFeature.name: Right Tool for the Job
entries: At 15th level, your mastery of firearms allows you to adapt to any situation. When you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you can replace any of your firearm upgrades with different ones. You can't have more than two Major Upgrades equipped at the same time. In addition, when you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}, you can replace one Minor Upgrade on your weapon with a different one. You must still meet the prerequisites for an upgrade to benefit from it.

subclassFeature.name: Make Them Explode
entries: At 18th level, you learn to channel the unstable force of gunpowder into a concussive explosive. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can throw or place an explosive. A thrown explosive has a range of 30 feet and detonates on impact. A placed explosive can be detonated remotely within 60 feet as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} or by one of your firearm attacks. Each creature within 15 feet of the explosive must make a Dexterity saving throw against your Firearm Upgrade DC, taking {@damage 9d6} Force damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success. A placed explosive instead deals {@damage 12d6} Force damage.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Lucky Card
entries: Some rogues prefer to hone their skills and precision, while others perfect a sharp tongue... but you? You always have an ace up your sleeve. Rogues of the Lucky Card archetype thrive on the chaos of high-stakes gambles and the thrill of the unpredictable. Armed with cunning, tricks, and no small amount of luck, these gamblers live and die by their own rules, never simply accepting the hand fate has dealt them.

subclassFeature.name: Lucky Draw
entries: When you choose this archetype at 3rd level, you learn the {@spell Guidance|XPHB} cantrip. It requires no Verbal components.
Starting at 9th level, when you cast the cantrip on yourself, its range becomes 30 feet, and you can cast it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Sharp Dealer
entries: You gain proficiency with {@item Playing Cards|XPHB} and a deck of enchanted cards, which you can use as a weapon. When you use it as a weapon the deck has the following statistics.
When you apply your Sneak Attack, roll its damage dice normally. The numbers rolled on the Card Deck's two damage dice determine which of the following effects you gain:

entries.name: Card Effects
items: 1 — Spades. The target takes extra damage equal to half the damage dealt by your Sneak Attack (rounded down).
2 — Diamonds. The target's Speed is halved, and it can't make more than one attack on its next turn.
3 — Hearts. You gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to half the damage dealt by your Sneak Attack.
4 — Clubs. Starting at 5th level, you can apply a Cunning Strike option without expending a Sneak Attack die.

entries: If both dice show the same result, you choose which of the two corresponding effects to apply. You can use this effect a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of 1). You regain one expended use when you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}, and all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
Finally, you can create an illusory deck of cards with no monetary value as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. The deck disappears if you remain more than 1 mile from it for 1 hour.

subclassFeature.name: Stacked Deck
entries: You always seem to know when it's time to fold. When the odds turn against you, you vanish in a flash. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within 120 feet of yourself. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Magic Trick
entries: Your mastery of cards has led you to develop innovative and occasionally controversial ways to escape sticky situations. You can cast {@spell Spray of Cards|BMT} without a spell slot a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of 1). You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this feature.

subclassFeature.name: Topdeck
entries: Your mastery of the gaming table sharpens your speed and cunning in combat. You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} rolls. In addition, after rolling Initiative but before the first turn of combat, you can choose to swap your place in the Initiative order with that creature.

subclassFeature.name: Winning Hand
entries: As an {@action Magic|XPHB|Magic Action}, you can throw a card at each creature of your choice within 90 feet of yourself. Each enemy creature in that area must make a Dexterity saving throw against a DC equal to 8 + your Proficiency Bonus + your Charisma modifier. On a failed save, a creature takes damage equal to the number rolled for your Sneak Attack. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage. In addition, you can rearrange the Initiative order of all creatures hit by the cards.
You can use this feature three times, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Lunari Cultist
entries: Some rogues prefer to hone their skills and precision, while others perfect a sharp tongue... but you? You always have an ace up your sleeve. Rogues of the Lunari Cultist archetype thrive on the chaos of high-stakes gambles and the thrill of the unpredictable. Armed with cunning, tricks, and no small amount of luck, these gamblers live and die by their own rules, never simply accepting the hand fate has dealt them.

subclassFeature.name: Moonlit Armament
entries: Your bond with the moon allows you to draw upon a portion of its power. You can form a mystical bond with up to two Simple or Martial weapons. To form a bond, you must spend a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB} meditating on one or more weapons while touching them. If the {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB} is interrupted or you are already bonded to two weapons, the attempt fails. Once bonded to a weapon, you can summon it to your hand or dismiss it as a {@action Magic|XPHB} Action, causing it to appear or vanish in a flash of pale moonlight. You can also summon or dismiss a bonded weapon as part of the {@action Attack|XPHB} action, or dismiss it immediately after dealing damage, requiring no action. A bonded weapon must be within 5 feet of you to be dismissed. The bond ends when you use a {@action Magic|XPHB} Action to end it or when you die. If you die, any bonded weapon that was dismissed appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you.

subclassFeature.name: Lunar Blessings
entries: At the start of Initiative, you can assign a different Lunar Blessing to each of your bonded weapons. A weapon can have only one blessing at a time, and the same blessing can't be assigned to more than one weapon.
When you expend a blessing, you can assign a new blessing to that weapon from among those you haven't yet used. Once you have expended all five blessings, all five become available again.
If you are wielding two bonded weapons, each weapon must have a different blessing.

items: {@b Calibrum.} When you miss with an attack using this weapon, you can expend its blessing to reroll the attack roll. You must use the new roll.
{@b Severum.} When you deal Sneak Attack damage with this weapon, you can expend its blessing to regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to half the Sneak Attack damage dealt, rounded down.

{@b Infernum.} When you deal Sneak Attack damage with this weapon, you can expend its blessing to deal Fire damage to each other creature of your choice within 10 feet of the target. The damage equals half the Sneak Attack damage dealt, rounded down.

{@b Gravitum.} When you hit a creature with this weapon, you can expend its blessing to reduce its Speed to 0 and prevent it from taking {@variantrule Reactions|XPHB} until the start of your next turn.

{@b Crescendum.} When you deal damage with this weapon, you can create an ethereal chakram that orbits you for 1 minute. You can have up to two chakrams at a time. When you deal damage with this weapon while you have one or more chakrams, you can expend its blessing to launch any number of those chakrams at the creature you damaged. Each chakram is destroyed on impact and deals {@damage 1d6} Radiant damage.

subclassFeature.name: Moonlit Veil
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks while you are in moonlight.

subclassFeature.name: Lunar Assault
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against creatures illuminated by moonlight. When you deal damage to a creature with an attack, you can bathe it in pale moonlight until the end of your next turn.

When you deal damage to a creature bathed in moonlight, you can empower the attack with lunar light, dealing an extra {@damage 1d6} Radiant damage and immediately moving up to 15 feet. This movement doesn't provoke {@variantrule Opportunity Attacks|XPHB} and doesn't count against your Speed for the turn.
You can deal this extra damage a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of 1). You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: More Sparkles!
entries: You gain a Spell Table containing eight spells chosen from the list below. When you gain this feature, choose eight spells from the list to add to your Spell Table. When an enemy creature within 30 feet of you dies, it leaves behind a Magic Shard. You can use your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to collect the shard.

When you collect a shard, roll {@dice 1d8}. The result determines which spell from your Spell Table you gain. You retain the spell for 8 hours or until you cast it. You can't collect another Magic Shard while you have a spell gained from this feature. Once you cast the spell, you lose it.

The saving throw DC for spells gained from this feature equals 8 + your Proficiency Bonus + your Wisdom modifier. Whenever you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you can replace one spell on your Spell Table with another spell from the list below. You can't have more than two spells of the same level on your Spell Table. When you reach 17th level, you can add 5th-level spells to your Spell Table.

entries.caption: Spell Table
rows: {@spell False Life|XPHB}, {@spell Spellfire Flare|FRHoF}, {@spell Divine Favor|XPHB}, {@spell Faerie Fire|XPHB}, {@spell Cloak of Shadow|BoET}, {@spell Ensnaring Strike|XPHB}
{@spell Invisibility|XPHB}, {@spell Silence|XPHB}, {@spell Blur|XPHB}, {@spell Misty Step|XPHB}, {@spell Ambush Prey|HWCS}, {@spell Mirror Image|XPHB}
{@spell Fear|XPHB}, {@spell Crusader's Mantle|XPHB}, {@spell Shadow Portal|BoET}, {@spell Major Image|XPHB}, {@spell Hypnotic Pattern|XPHB}, {@spell Nondetection|XPHB}
{@spell Confusion|XPHB}, {@spell Dimension Door|XPHB}, {@spell Hallucinatory Terrain|XPHB}, {@spell Greater Invisibility|XPHB}, {@spell Phantasmal Killer|XPHB}, {@spell Stellar Bodies|HWCS}
{@spell Alustriel's Mooncloak|FRHoF}, {@spell Commune|XPHB}, {@spell Conjure Volley|XPHB}, {@spell Dispel Evil and Good|XPHB}, {@spell Mislead|XPHB}, {@spell Far Step|XGE}

subclassFeature.name: Moonlit Strikes
entries: When you make an attack roll against a creature illuminated by moonlight, the attack scores a Critical Hit on a roll of 19 or 20 on the {@dice d20}.

subclassFeature.name: Way of Kinkou
entries: The Kinkou Order is an ancient Ionian organization dedicated to preserving the balance between the physical world and the spirit realm. The Kinkou hone both body and spirit, using each to strengthen the other.

subclassFeature.name: Twilight Sight
entries: Your perception transcends the physical world, allowing you to sense disturbances in the balance. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can enter a heightened state of awareness for 1 minute. During this time:

items: You know when an {@condition invisible|XPHB} creature is within 10 feet of you, though you don't know its exact location.
You know whether a creature within 30 feet of you is affected by a spell.
You know whether a creature within 30 feet of you is possessed or influenced by an extraplanar force.

entries: You can use this feature a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}. You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Disrupting Strikes
entries: Your strikes disrupt the inner harmony of your foes. Once per turn, when you hit a creature with an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, you can impose one of the following effects on it until the start of your next turn:

items: {@b Physical Disruption.} The creature takes a −2 penalty to its {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB}.
{@b Mental Disruption.} The creature has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the next saving throw it makes.

subclassFeature.name: Spirit-Matter Step
entries: You have learned to move between the Material Plane and the Spirit Realm. When you use Step of the Wind, you gain the following benefits until the end of the turn:

items: You can move through the space of other creatures and objects of your size or larger without treating those spaces as {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}.
Your movement doesn't provoke {@variantrule Opportunity Attacks|XPHB}.
The first attack that hits during this turn deals extra Radiant or Necrotic damage (your choice) equal to one roll of your Martial Arts die.

subclassFeature.name: Inner Balance
entries: When your body falters, your spirit grows stronger. At the start of your turn, if you have {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to or less than half your {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} maximum, you gain one of the following benefits until the start of your next turn:

items: You gain a +2 bonus to Armor Class.
You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells that impose conditions or force you to move or attack.

subclassFeature.name: Judgment of Balance
entries: You can punish those who disrupt the harmony. When you hit a creature affected by one of your Disrupting Strikes, you can spend 1 Focus Point to impose one of the following effects:

items: {@b Spiritual Silence.} The creature can't cast spells with Verbal components until the start of your next turn.
{@b Flow Lock.} The creature's Speed becomes 0 until the start of your next turn.
{@b Restored Order.} The creature takes extra damage equal to two rolls of your Martial Arts die and can't take {@variantrule Reactions|XPHB} until the start of your next turn.

subclassFeature.name: Twilight Form
entries: You embody the perfect balance between light and shadow. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can spend 4 Focus Points to assume this form for 1 minute. During this time, you gain the following benefits:

items: At the end of each of your turns, you gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to 10 times the number of Focus Points you spent to activate this feature. The Temporary Hit Points you gain from this feature accumulate with those gained from this feature on previous turns.
When you hit with an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, you automatically apply both effects of Disrupting Strikes.
You can use the additional benefits of Step of the Wind without spending Focus Points.

subclassFeature.name: Oath of the Solari
entries: Devoted to the worship of the sun, the Solari are the elite warriors of the Rakkor people. They draw celestial power directly from within themselves, wielding it to protect Targon, annihilate their enemies, and destroy every source of false light.

subclassFeature.name: Oath of Solari Spells
entries: When you reach a Paladin level specified in the Oath of Solari Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

subclassFeature.name: Solar Barrier
entries: When you take damage, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to expend a use of Channel Divinity and gain {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to all damage types until the end of your next turn. When this effect ends, radiant light erupts from you. Each creature of your choice within a 10-foot Emanation originating from you takes {@damage 1d8} + your Charisma modifier Radiant damage.

subclassFeature.name: Illumination
entries: After you deal Radiant damage to a creature using a Channel Divinity option or a Paladin spell, you can mark that creature with unstable light until the start of your next turn. If a creature other than you deals damage to the marked creature, the mark detonates. The marked creature takes an extra {@damage 1d12} Radiant damage, and the mark ends. A creature can have only one Light Mark at a time.

subclassFeature.name: Flaming Trail
entries: Once per turn, when you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action, you can replace one of your attacks with a ranged attack against a creature you can see within 30 feet, using the same melee weapon you are wielding.

items: {@b Miss.} The weapon disappears and reappears in your hand.
{@b Hit.} The attack deals damage normally, and you teleport to the nearest unoccupied space to the target with the weapon in hand.

subclassFeature.name: I AM THE SUN
entries: You can infuse yourself with divine light. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you gain the following benefits for 1 minute. You can end this effect at any time (no action required). Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
You can also regain one expended use of this feature by expending a 5th-level spell slot (no action required).

entries.name: Solar Aura
entries: A brilliant aura of light erupts from your chest, extending to the radius of your Aura. Each creature of your choice in the aura must make a Constitution saving throw.

items: {@b Failure.} The creature takes {@damage 6d8} Radiant damage.
{@b Success.} The creature takes half as much damage.

entries: Undead and Oozes have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on this saving throw.

entries.name: Stunning Radiance
entries: When you deal Radiant damage to a creature with a spell or a feature of this class, you can force it to make a Constitution saving throw against your Paladin spell save DC. On a failed save, the creature has the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn.

subclassFeature.name: Sentinel
entries: The Sentinels are hunters who wield an ancient magic, infusing it into their weapons to fight and vanquish evil.

subclassFeature.name: Sentinel Spells
entries: When you reach a Ranger level specified in the Sentinel Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

subclassFeature.name: Chosen Weapon
entries: You can imbue your weapons with the essence of your Sentinel Oath. Once per turn, when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can deal an extra 1d6 damage of your chosen type. This extra damage increases to 2d6 at 11th level.
When you gain this feature, choose one of the following damage types:

items: {@b Radiant.} You hunt the Mist.
{@b Necrotic.} You hunt Celestials.
{@b Psychic.} You hunt mages.
{@b Thunder.} You hunt the Void.

entries: Your choice determines the damage type of the extra damage and can't be changed unless a feature allows you to change it.

subclassFeature.name: Spark Mark
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can mark one creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself for 1 minute. The mark ends early if you are {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB}. For the duration, the marked creature sheds {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} in a 10-foot radius and doesn't benefit from the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition. The first time on each of your allies' turns that an ally hits the marked creature with an attack, the attack deals extra damage equal to your Wisdom modifier. This extra damage is the same type as the extra damage dealt by your Chosen Weapon feature. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}. You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Shelter Step
entries: When you take damage, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. If you end the teleport within 5 feet of an ally, you and that ally gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your Ranger level. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of 1), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Purifying Barrage
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB|Magic Action}, you can channel your inner strength and project a beam in a 60-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line. Each creature in the Line must make a Dexterity saving throw against your Ranger spell save DC. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 4d8} damage of the type determined by your Chosen Weapon feature and suffers an additional effect based on that damage type:

items: {@b Radiant.} The creature has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn.
{@b Necrotic.} The creature can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} until the start of your next turn.
{@b Psychic.} The creature can't cast spells until the start of your next turn.
{@b Thunder.} The creature has the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the start of your next turn.

entries: On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Dawn Defender
entries: You gain {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to the damage type associated with your Chosen Weapon feature.
In addition, you can expend two uses of Favored Enemy to activate this feature. For the next 10 minutes, you and each ally within 60 feet of you when you activate it gain the following benefits:

items: You have Advantage on saving throws against the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} and {@condition Frightened|XPHB} conditions.
At the start of each of your turns, you and each ally affected by this feature gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to twice your Wisdom modifier.

subclassFeature.name: Bandle Sorcery
entries: Occasionally, a yordle leaves the Fey realm of Bandle City to venture into Aetherion, or a mortal stumbles upon it and returns from their magical journey forever changed.

subclassFeature.name: Bandle Spells
entries: When you reach a Sorcerer level specified in the Bandle Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

entries.caption: Bandle Spells
rows: {@spell Color Spray|XPHB}, {@spell Druidcraft|XPHB}, {@spell Enlarge/Reduce|XPHB}, {@spell Chaos Bolt|XGE}

subclassFeature.name: Timeless
entries: Exposure to Bandle City has altered your body, causing you to age much more slowly. For every 3 years that pass, your body ages only 1 year.

subclassFeature.name: Whimsy
entries: When you cast a spell using a spell slot that targets one or more creatures, you can choose one of those creatures and roll {@dice 1d6} on either the Beneficial Whimsy or Detrimental Whimsy table.

entries.caption: Beneficial Whimsy
rows: The creature regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your Charisma modifier. Any Hit Points restored beyond its maximum become {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.
The creature gains a {@dice 1d4} bonus to attack rolls, saving throws, and ability checks until the end of its next turn.
The creature teleports up to 10 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.
The next {@dice d20} Test the creature makes before the end of its next turn that has a roll of 1–9 becomes a 10.
The next attack roll made against the creature before the end of your next turn has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.
Choose another beneficial effect from this table.

entries.caption: Detrimental Whimsy
rows: The creature takes damage equal to your Charisma modifier.
The creature subtracts {@dice 1d4} from attack rolls, saving throws, and ability checks until the end of its next turn.
You teleport the creature up to 10 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.
The creature's Speed is halved until the end of its next turn.
The next attack roll made against the creature before the end of your next turn has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}.
Choose another detrimental effect from this table.

subclassFeature.name: Mischievous Magic
entries: When you spend a Sorcery Point on a spell that triggers your Whimsy feature, you can choose one additional effect from either the Beneficial Whimsy or Detrimental Whimsy table.

subclassFeature.name: Hidden Paths
entries: You can perform a ritual to create a one-use portal to Bandle City. The ritual requires 4 hours of work each day for 7 consecutive days. If you miss a day, you must start the ritual over.

subclassFeature.name: Wild Growth
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can cause one ally you can see within 60 feet of yourself to become enlarged for 1 minute, or until you use this feature again.
You can also use this feature as a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} when a creature is hit by an attack or fails a saving throw.
The target's size becomes Large if it is smaller than Large. If it is already Large, its size doesn't change.

Each creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw against your spell save DC or be pushed up to 10 feet away from the target and have the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.
When you use this feature, you can also apply one Positive or Negative effect from your Whimsy table.

entries.name: While Enlarged
entries: The target's current and maximum {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} each increase by an amount equal to your Sorcerer level + your Charisma modifier for the duration.
The target has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength and Constitution ability checks and saving throws.
The target's weapon attacks and Unarmed Strikes deal an extra {@damage 1d6} damage.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, unless you expend 4 Sorcery Points (no action required) to regain its use.

subclassFeature.name: Magical Journey
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can create a temporary portal to Bandle City and call upon its inhabitants for aid. The portal functions like the {@spell Gate|XPHB} spell, with the following modifications:

items: You don't expend a spell slot to create the portal.
The portal doesn't require any spell components.
The portal is one-way, allowing creatures to travel only from Bandle City to the space where you created the portal.

When you create the portal and at the start of each of your turns while you maintain Concentration on the portal, you can cast {@spell Summon Fey|XPHB} without expending a spell slot or requiring Concentration. The spell's casting time is a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} for you, and the summoned Fey appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the portal.
When the portal closes, all Fey summoned by this feature disappear.

entries: Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Mist Patron
entries: You are somehow bound to the Shadow Isles and the Black Mist that surrounds them. Whether through misfortune, a dark pact, or a conscious choice, you wield the power of the Black Mist. Your patron is likely the Ruined King, a notorious wraith of the Mist, or perhaps the Mist itself.

subclassFeature.name: Mist Spells
entries: When you reach a Warlock level specified in the Mist Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

entries.caption: Mist Spells
rows: {@spell Arms of Hadar|XPHB}, {@spell False Life|XPHB}, {@spell Darkness|XPHB}, {@spell Shadow Blade|XGE}

subclassFeature.name: Dark Mist Curse
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can manifest a sphere of Black Mist around yourself with a radius of 90 feet. The mist lasts for 1 minute, until you use this feature again, or until you dismiss it (no action required).

entries.name: Benefits of the Black Mist
entries: A creature in the mist is Cursed.

items: When you deal damage to a Cursed creature with a spell or weapon attack, you deal an extra {@damage 1d6} Necrotic damage to it.
When you use this feature, you can designate any number of creatures that are unaffected by the mist.

When a Cursed creature within the mist is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, you can choose another Cursed creature within the mist. That creature takes an extra {@damage 1d6} Necrotic damage.
On each of your turns after the turn you activate this feature, you can move the mist up to 10 feet as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

entries: Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}, or until you expend a Pact Magic spell slot to regain its use.

subclassFeature.name: Mist's Grasp
entries: While you are inside the Black Mist, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to attempt to bind Cursed creatures within the mist. Each Cursed creature in the mist must make a Strength saving throw against your Warlock spell save DC.

items: {@b Failure.} The creature has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition. At the end of each of its turns, it can take an action to repeat the saving throw, ending the condition on itself on a success.
{@b Success.} The creature's Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

entries: In addition, when you cast a Necromancy spell that deals damage to a Cursed creature, the spell deals an extra {@damage 1d6} Necrotic damage.

subclassFeature.name: Mist Wraiths
entries: You learn the {@spell Danse Macabre|XGE} spell. It counts as a Warlock spell for you, but it doesn't count against the number of spells you know.
You can also cast the spell once without expending a spell slot. You regain the ability to do so when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
In addition, you don't need corpses to cast the spell. Instead of corpses, you create ephemeral Ghouls formed from corporeal mist. These Ghouls use the Zombie stat block.

subclassFeature.name: Dread
entries: While you are within your Dark Mist, your Speed increases by 10 feet, and your movement doesn't provoke {@variantrule Opportunity Attacks|XPHB}.

In addition, when a creature enters the mist for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, you can grant that creature {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your Proficiency Bonus + your Charisma modifier.

hp.special: five times your Artificer level (the Drone has a number of Hit Dice [d8s] equal to your Artificer level)

trait.name: Evasion
entries: If the drone is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage on a successful save and only half damage on a failed one. It can't use this trait while Incapacitated.

trait.name: Magical Bond
entries: Add your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} to any ability check or saving throw the drone makes.

trait.name: Chemical Diffuser
entries: When you cast a 1st-level spell or higher that restores {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} to a creature, the drone can release the excess chemical compounds toward one creature of your choice within 30 feet of it. The target must make a Dexterity saving throw against your Artificer spell save DC. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 1d4} acid or poison damage plus the level of the spell slot used.

trait.name: Chemical Synthesis
entries: When you cast a 1st-level spell or higher, the drone can spread a refined compound to a creature of your choice within 30 feet of it. That creature gains {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to {@damage 1d4} per level of the spell slot used.

trait.name: Land Shell
entries: The Scuttle Crab has resistance to all bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. If the Scuttle Crab is subjected to a mass-control condition (Grappled, Incapacitated, Paralyzed, Prone, Frightened, or Restrained), its shell closes: it loses this resistance, and its AC decreases to 12 until the end of the encounter.

trait.name: Evasive Moves
entries: The Scuttle Crab can take the Disengage or Dash action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

trait.name: Shrine of the Tide
entries: When the Scuttle Crab drops to 0 hit points or is successfully pacified/captured by the players, its spirit releases a ball of blue light that floats at the center of the river/area for 1 hour, illuminating a 20-foot radius.

action.name: Scuttling Pinch
entries: {@atk m} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) bludgeoning damage.

monsterFluff.name: Scuttle Crab
entries: The Scuttle Crab is a pacific creature and wont attack in many situations only if cornered and can't escape in any method, he really like the Honeyfruit and will try to steal them away from other creatures.

item.name: Outlaw Rifle
entries: {@b Piercing.} At the start of your turn, you can take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action to forgo all the attacks you would normally make as part of that action. If you do so, make one attack with the rifle with {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}. On a hit, the attack deals an extra {@damage 1d8} for each point of your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}. The target must then succeed on a Constitution saving throw against your Outlaw DC or have the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} and {@condition Prone|XPHB} conditions until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Reload
entries: This weapon can be used to make a number of attacks before it must be reloaded. If you are proficient with the weapon, reloading it takes an {@variantrule Action|XPHB} or a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}; otherwise, reloading it takes an {@variantrule Action|XPHB}.

optionalfeature.name: Arcane Bolas
entries: Your firearm contains two charges that can be used to fire an arcane net. As an {@variantrule Action|XPHB}, choose one creature within your firearm's normal range. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw against your Outlaw DC or have the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition.
At the end of each of its turns, the creature can repeat the saving throw, ending the condition on itself on a success.
Whether the creature succeeds or fails the initial saving throw, one charge is expended. You regain all expended charges when you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}.

optionalfeature.name: Bored Barrel
entries: Your firearm's ranged attacks don't have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} when made against targets beyond the weapon's normal range.

optionalfeature.name: Smoke Screen
entries: Your firearm contains a special projectile that releases a cloud of smoke. As an {@variantrule Action|XPHB}, you can fire the projectile at a point within your firearm's range. On impact, the projectile creates a 10-foot-radius sphere of smoke that spreads around corners. The area is {@variantrule Heavily Obscured|XPHB}.
The smoke lasts for 10 minutes. A strong wind disperses the smoke for 1 round, after which the smoke reforms.. Covering the point of impact with an opaque object prevents the smoke from spreading.
Once you fire this projectile, you can't use it again until you prepare another one during a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}.

optionalfeature.name: Bayonet
entries: You attach a blade to your firearm that has the statistics of a {@item Shortsword|XPHB}. You can use the Shortsword's Light property even while wielding your firearm.

optionalfeature.name: Scope
entries: If you haven't moved during this turn, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to reduce your Speed to 0 until the end of the turn. You then have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the next attack roll you make with your firearm before the end of the turn.

optionalfeature.name: Simple Magazine
entries: You have redesigned your firearm's magazines to make them lighter and easier to load. Your Firearm Specialist weapon ignores the Reload property.

optionalfeature.name: Pneumatic Stabilizer
entries: While wielding your firearm with both hands, you don't have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on ranged attack rolls while you have the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition or when targeting creatures that have the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.
In addition, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom (Perception) and Dexterity (Stealth) checks while you are {@condition Prone|XPHB}.

optionalfeature.name: Suppressor
entries: You equip your pistol with a suppressor. Your firearm makes no sound when you make an attack with it or use one of its upgrades.

optionalfeature.name: Hair Trigger
entries: When a creature within your firearm's normal range makes an attack against you, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} and expend one piece of ammunition to attempt to disarm the attacker.

The creature must succeed on a Strength saving throw against your Outlaw DC or drop one weapon it is holding. Whether the creature succeeds or fails, the triggering attack still hits you and deals damage as normal.

optionalfeature.name: Sawed-Off Barrel
entries: Your shortened barrel makes your shots less reliable but more lethal. When you make an attack roll with your firearm and roll a 3 or lower on the {@dice d20}, the attack is a critical failure, regardless of the attack's modifiers.
In addition, whenever you roll damage for an attack with your firearm, roll one additional weapon damage die.
If you suffer a critical failure because of this upgrade, you must spend your next turn repairing your firearm. During that turn, you can't make attacks or use your firearm's abilities.

optionalfeature.name: Shooting the Red Cross
entries: Your firearm responds to your injuries. The first time you make an attack with your firearm after you regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}, the attack deals an extra {@damage 1d12} damage.
The attack also deals this extra damage if its target has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition or has a Speed of 0.

optionalfeature.name: Multiple Barrel
entries: Your firearm gains a second barrel. Immediately after you make an attack with your firearm, you can make two attacks with it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} instead of the single attack normally granted by the Light property.

optionalfeature.name: Thunderous Barrel
entries: Your firearm can be fitted with stolen magical or Hextech technology. As an {@variantrule Action|XPHB}, you can charge your firearm with arcane energy and fire a bolt of lightning in a 100-foot-long, 5-foot-wide line.

Each creature in the line must make a Dexterity saving throw against your Outlaw DC. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 8d6} Lightning damage. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage.
Once you use this upgrade, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}.

optionalfeature.name: Hextech Barrel
entries: Your firearm is fitted with a modified barrel using stolen magical or Hextech technology. The damage dealt by your firearm becomes Force damage.
Ammunition fired from your firearm no longer benefits from any magical bonus it previously had.

optionalfeature.name: Explosive Cartridge
entries: As an {@variantrule Action|XPHB}, you can load an overcharged cartridge into your firearm and make an attack with it. You can target a surface or object instead of a creature.

On impact, the cartridge explodes violently. Each creature within 5 feet of the point of impact for each point of your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} of the point of impact must make a Dexterity saving throw against your Outlaw DC.

On a failed save, a creature takes a number of {@damage d6s} equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} in Force damage and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and suffers no other effect.
An unattended object or door takes twice as much damage from the explosion.

optionalfeature.name: Hextech Piercing Round
entries: When you use the Action granted by the Rifle's Piercing property, you can fire a high-density round. The attack ignores {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Half Cover} and {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Three-Quarters Cover}.

If the attack reduces a creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, the projectile continues in a straight line for up to 30 feet beyond the target. If the projectile encounters another creature, make another attack roll against that creature without the additional damage or other effects granted by the Piercing property.
You can use this upgrade a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}. You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

optionalfeature.name: Rain of Lead
entries: You expend two charges from your firearm's magazine. As an {@action Magic|XPHB|Magic Action}, you unleash a barrage of bullets in a 20-foot Cone. Make an attack roll against each creature in the area, including your allies.
You can use this upgrade a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}. You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
